cases.setup: Pin a public Python checkout with the reported omission. Bind current public analyzer argv for the match reproduction and equivalent if/else control. Capture the initial source diff and locate candidate classifier and test owners.

checks.observation: Capture analyzer diagnostics for both public snippets with argv, interpreter and exit status.
checks.expected: The match snippet reports redefinition of the case-local function name; the equivalent if/else snippet does not report that redefinition.

checks.observation: Inspect the branch-sensitive redefinition call chain and record hashed anchors for its shared classifier and match test owner.
checks.expected: The actual classifier used by the diagnostic recognizes existing alternatives but lacks separate match case bodies; both current owner bindings are recorded.

checks.observation: Inspect the emitted context and compare source diffs before and after the probe.
checks.expected: Confirmed context is emitted only after both diagnostic and ownership checks pass; checkout source diff is unchanged.

cases.setup: Provide confirmed probe context and a bound current classifier. Use public AST fixtures containing a two-case match, an if, and a try. Record pre-edit classifier results for the if and try fixtures.

checks.observation: Inspect the diff and invoke the current classifier on the two-case match AST.
checks.expected: The result has two alternatives corresponding to the two original case bodies; no combined case body or global diagnostic suppression is introduced.

checks.observation: Compare the post-edit if and try classifier results with their recorded pre-edit shapes.
checks.expected: The if and try results retain their prior body grouping and handler grouping.

checks.observation: Review runtime support and the ast.Match access path; inspect output state, invalidation records and verification closure.
checks.expected: Unavailable ast.Match is not accessed on supported older runtimes; classifier output is modified-unvalidated; prior diagnostic and adjacent observations are stale; validate remains linked to recognize.

cases.setup: Provide confirmed context and a bound public match suite. Record existing assertions and runtime gating before adding the regression.

checks.observation: Read the added test fixture and assertion through the current harness.
checks.expected: The fixture defines the same function name in case 1 and case _, uses the name after the match, and expects no unused-name redefinition diagnostic.

checks.observation: Run the added assertion against the pinned original omission and the repaired classifier using public test commands.
checks.expected: The original omission causes the added assertion to fail because of the redefinition diagnostic; the repaired classifier passes the assertion. Missing execution remains UNKNOWN.

checks.observation: Compare the suite diff, runtime gating, output state and verification closure.
checks.expected: Existing assertions and version gating are unchanged; the test output is modified-unvalidated; validate remains linked to regression.

cases.setup: Provide both edit outputs and current public Oracle bindings. Prepare the added regression, existing match tests, if/else and try controls, and a public sequential control consisting of two unused definitions of the same function name in one scope. Bind runtime compatibility checks to the supported policy.

checks.observation: Execute the bound regression and match-suite argv and capture exit status, test results and diagnostic output.
checks.expected: The added regression passes with no target redefinition diagnostic, and existing match tests pass.

checks.observation: Execute the if/else, try-alternative and sequential-redefinition public controls; compare alternative controls with pre-edit observations.
checks.expected: If/else and try behavior is unchanged; the genuine sequential unused-name redefinition still produces its redefinition diagnostic.

checks.observation: Inspect or execute the bound supported-runtime availability checks and record which runtimes were covered.
checks.expected: No supported runtime accesses an unavailable ast.Match; unavailable coverage is recorded as UNKNOWN rather than PASS.

checks.observation: Inspect the validation record, Oracle check keys and checkout diff after validation.
checks.expected: The record includes current argv, interpreter, exit status and per-check PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN under oracle:<action_id>:<source_oracle_id>; any missing or failing required check prevents public-validation-passed; validation adds no source edits.

checks.observation: Inspect the reported acceptance scope and provenance references.
checks.expected: Changed-test-only results are not described as whole-project, cross-project or hidden acceptance; no historical execution is invented.
